title: Security WAF ModSecurity Entity
description: ModSecurity-specific configuration. Extends Security/WAF with ModSecurity-specific settings.

sec_rule_engine.description: SecRuleEngine directive controlling the rule engine.

sec_request_body_limit.description: Maximum request body size in bytes.

sec_pcre_match_limit.description: PCRE match limit to prevent ReDoS.

sec_pcre_match_limit_recursion.description: PCRE match limit recursion to prevent ReDoS.

crs_paranoia_level.description: OWASP CRS paranoia level (1 = low, 4 = high).

crs_exclusions.description: Application-specific CRS exclusion profiles (e.g., wordpress, drupal, nextcloud).
